svg.title: Scalable ML Trading System Architecture
svg.desc: Six-layer architecture: Market Data, Feature Engineering, Strategy Layer, Risk Engine, Execution, and Monitoring

g.text: Unified feed handler with symbol normalization and timestamp alignment
Deterministic, point-in-time correct. No lookahead leakage.
Each strategy is isolated, versioned, and independently togglable
All orders pass through. No strategy bypasses this layer.
Unified order interface. Swap brokers without touching strategy logic.
Feeds back into feature store and model retraining
